name: Wi-Fi Clipboard Sync v1.0.6
changelog:
🚀 Stability, Camera & Auto-Updater Release (v1.0.6):
- Android Camera & Video Crash Permanent Fix: ignores privacy/camera/mic indicators in SystemUI overlay
- Windows Auto-Updater Atomic Rename (.old) and zero console window flashing
- Luminescent Connection Orb & Obsidian Glass UI
- 100% automated in-app updates for both Android and Windows
⚠️ Note for v1.0.1 users: Please uninstall v1.0.1 once before installing.
